s: Quorum-driven selection of ONE active coordinator among replicas with automatic failover.
w: Candidates campaign via heartbeats/leases through consensus store (etcd/zookeeper) or Raft membership; quorum agreement installs leader identity. Watchers notify followers of leadership changes; split-brain prevented because minority can't renew leases. Failure detection timeouts tune failover speed vs false-positive flapping.
use: Active-passive service failover (one writer at a time)
avoid: Multi-active designs where any-replica-can-serve simplifies everything
pits: Flapping leaders under network partitions - stabilize with randomized jitter + majority-quorum checks
tips: Explain WHY quorum prevents split-brain mathematically (intersecting majorities)
